hero_diversity_direction: Art direction for this set: make this class visually distinct from other heroes through the specified physique, garment construction, head shape and material palette. Preserve its own portrait identity. Avoid repeating the Knight's broad steel shoulder plates, leather straps and tower ornaments on unrelated classes. Emphasize this subject's described signature features. Rigging priority: arms visibly angled 35 degrees out from vertical with generous continuous background gaps, both hands empty and clear of hips, legs separated, hems above knees, no cloth between thighs. Uniform flat grey background.

corrections.de_dreadmarshal: Edit only the hair for 3D rigging suitability. Preserve the character identity, face, armour, body proportions, empty hands, full-body A-pose, separated legs, short clothing, flat grey background and image composition. One figure only, no text or props. Keep everything else unchanged.
